'''Dak Haron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was quite successful in convincing the unaligned Outer Rim systems into joining the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
